items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: his sister happens to be the wife of Max Gordon who owns the Village Vanguard

ctx.x: It's also on the cover of this.

The album cover. So I said to myself, I wonder how much this guy is going to charge. He said, "It's all yours." The next thing I must do, "Wouldn't you like to make an album?" I said, "Who don't? Sure I want to make an album." "I tell you what we could do. We could put up some money -- I could put up some money -- I said, how much would it take about?" "It would take about $3,000." So he put up some money, I put up some money and my sister put up some money and his sister happens to be the wife of Max Gordon who…
